title: The Rook Goes First
setup: Black's rook is on a7, its bishop on c5 and another rook on g5 — its pieces are everywhere and yours are not.
hint: Your queen looks like the piece to play. Try the other one and see who is forced to block.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rd8+}} sends the rook, not the queen. {{Bf8}} is the only interposition, and {{Rxf8#}} is mate, since g7 and h7 hold Black's own pawns. Send the piece you can afford to lose and keep the queen.
